data.page_description: Where Relief's facility information comes from, how it's kept accurate, and how to contribute.
data.heading: Data & Sources
data.how_intro: Relief combines facility information from external datasets and, in future, community contributions. The database records the source of each entry so we can keep track of where information came from.
data.how_provenance: Provenance is recorded: each facility record carries information about its source.
data.how_stale: Data can become stale or incorrect. Facilities close, move, or change. Please report corrections so we can keep things up to date.
data.how_authoritative: When enriching records, Relief aims to prefer authoritative and current evidence over older or unverified information.
data.how_reconcile: When the same facility appears in multiple sources, we reconcile the records into one entry rather than showing duplicates.
data.toilet_map_uk: The current Relief database uses the Toilet Map UK dataset as its baseline source of facility information.
data.future_sources: We are researching additional authoritative sources, including transport operators, councils, and specialist accessibility organisations. These are not yet part of Relief's live dataset and are described as future enrichment work.
data.contributions_text: On this public website, facility contributions and corrections from the community are not currently enabled. The Relief mobile app has an authenticated facility-submission flow, and its facility reports and correction requests are stored against the submitting user ID. The mobile audit does not establish the moderation or publication process for those submissions.
data.report_corrections: For this website, if you spot incorrect information, email data@findrelief.co.uk. The website does not currently accept submissions through a form; mobile-app reports and correction requests are a separate authenticated flow.
data.cta_text: Are you an organisation with facility data you'd like to share, or corrections to suggest? Email data@findrelief.co.uk.
